name: 10pines-c17-customerimporter-4
title: Customer Importer 4: supplier import with TDD
description: The tested, database-decoupled customer importer must grow into an ERP system: add with TDD an import of suppliers from records S (supplier), NC (new customer of the supplier), EC (existing customer of the supplier) and A (supplier address), with the same validation of record types and field counts, reusing the customer import logic and keeping transient and persistent implementations selectable by the environment.

design.notes: Adding a second importer that shares the record loop, the address import and the customer-record parsing with the existing one forces extracting a PartyImporter superclass (pull up), a Party superclass of Customer and Supplier, a PartyIdentification parameter object for the type/number pairs, and an ErpSystem composed of customer and supplier sub-systems in transient and persistent variants; the supplier importer must look customers up in the customer sub-system.
